attchmntText: Everest Kanto Cylinder Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Everest Kanto Cylinder Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The Board appointed Mr. Sanjiv Kapur, DIN 07576794, as Wholetime Director for a further period of three years commencing November 1, 2026. This appointment is subject to approval by members via postal ballot. Mr. Kapur will continue as Chief Financial Officer. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 45,772. Profit after tax stood at 3,955. Basic earnings per share were 3.52. The statutory auditors, Suresh Surana & Associates LLP, issued an unmodified opinion on the results. The meeting commenced at 2:30 p.m. and concluded at 5:25 p.m. on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Everest Kanto Cylinder Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Everest Kanto Cylinder Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The Statutory Auditors, Suresh Surana & Associates LLP, issued an unmodified opinion on these results. The Board also proposed the appointment of Mr. Sanjiv Kapur, DIN 07576794, as Wholetime Director for a further period of three years commencing from November 1, 2026. This appointment is subject to approval by Members via Postal Ballot. Mr. Kapur will continue to serve as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel. He is a Chartered Accountant with over 42 years of experience. He is not related to any other Director and is not debarred from holding office. The financial results will be uploaded on the company website.

attchmntText: Everest Kanto Cylinder Limited has informed the Exchange that, EKC Egypt SAE, a subsidiary of the Company has entered a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Natural Gas Vehicles Company (CARGAS), one of the pioneering companies in Egyptian petroleum sector in the field of Compressed Natural Gas (CNG), to study and develop opportunities for implementing a project to manufacture CNG transportation units (MEGCs) for the delivery of CNG through Virtual Pipeline System to the consumers in the Egyptian domestic markets, the Middle East and African markets.
Everest Kanto Cylinder Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update on Egypt Unit'.
